input: Explore glassblowing workshops in the city

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether they want a one-time taster session, a multi-week course, or just want to browse options changes what to look for entirely.
Whether this is for themselves alone, a group, a date, or a gift affects the type of workshop (private, group, beginner-friendly, etc.).
The specific city determines which studios and workshops actually exist and are reachable.
Budget range will filter out high-end private studios or multi-session courses that may be too costly.
A target date or timeframe (weekend, specific month) narrows which workshops have available slots and affects urgency of booking.
Experience level (complete beginner vs. some prior exposure) shapes which workshops are appropriate and what to emphasise in the search.
Knowing whether the goal is to simply attend and have fun, create a finished piece to keep, or seriously learn a skill changes what a 'good' workshop looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Find and explore glassblowing workshops nearby
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to discover glassblowing workshops available in their city, likely to attend or book one.

questions.title: Which city are you looking for workshops in?
questions.description: Identify the specific city or neighbourhood to search within.

questions.title: Is this a one-time taster or a multi-session course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a short drop-in experience or a structured ongoing course.

questions.title: Who is this workshop experience for?
questions.description: Determine if this is a solo activity, a group outing, a date, or a gift for someone else.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for this?
questions.description: Establish a rough price range to filter workshops accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Find out if there is a specific date, weekend, or month the user is aiming for.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with glassblowing?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner or has some prior exposure to the craft.

questions.title: What would make this workshop feel worthwhile to you?
questions.description: Clarify the primary goal — fun experience, a piece to take home, skill development, etc.
